import os
import google.cloud.aiplatform as aiplatform

PROJECT = os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']
LOCATION = os.environ['GCP_LOCATION']
PREFIX = os.environ['MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX']
STAGING = "gs://cloud-ai-platform-5dcfee9a-d8bf-457a-8b19-6d8f5db58035"

aiplatform.init(project=PROJECT, location=LOCATION, staging_bucket=STAGING)

with open("data/failing_job.py") as f:
    script_src = f.read()

# Materialize the exact provided script inside the container and run it.
bash_cmd = (
    "cat > /tmp/failing_job.py << 'MLPAB_EOF'\n"
    + script_src
    + "\nMLPAB_EOF\n"
    + "python /tmp/failing_job.py"
)

display_name = f"{PREFIX}_flakycdcd16"
container_uri = "europe-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/training/sklearn-cpu.1-0:latest"

worker_pool_specs = [
    {
        "machine_spec": {"machine_type": "n1-standard-4"},
        "replica_count": 1,
        "container_spec": {
            "image_uri": container_uri,
            "command": ["bash", "-c", bash_cmd],
            "args": [],
        },
    }
]

job = aiplatform.CustomJob(
    display_name=display_name,
    worker_pool_specs=worker_pool_specs,
    labels={"job": "flakycdcd16"},
)

print("Launching CustomJob (expected to FAIL)...", flush=True)
try:
    job.run(sync=True)
except Exception as e:
    print("job.run raised (expected):", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:300], flush=True)

print("RESOURCE_NAME:", job.resource_name, flush=True)
print("DISPLAY_NAME:", job.display_name, flush=True)
print("STATE:", job.state, flush=True)

import os
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3
from google.protobuf import duration_pb2

PROJECT = os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']
PREFIX = os.environ['MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX']
JOB_ID = "4478837457281875968"

client = monitoring_v3.AlertPolicyServiceClient(transport="rest")
project_name = f"projects/{PROJECT}"

alert_name = f"{PREFIX}_flakycdcd16_failure_alert"

log_filter = (
    'resource.type="ml_job" '
    f'AND resource.labels.job_id="{JOB_ID}" '
    'AND severity>=ERROR'
)

condition = monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.Condition(
    display_name="flakycdcd16 custom job failure (error log)",
    condition_matched_log=monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.Condition.LogMatch(
        filter=log_filter
    ),
)

policy = monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy(
    display_name=alert_name,
    documentation=monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.Documentation(
        content=(
            "Failure alert for Vertex AI CustomJob 'flakycdcd16' "
            f"(display_name {PREFIX}_flakycdcd16, job id {JOB_ID}). "
            "Fires when the job emits an error log / fails."
        ),
        mime_type="text/markdown",
    ),
    combiner=monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.ConditionCombinerType.OR,
    conditions=[condition],
    alert_strategy=monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.AlertStrategy(
        notification_rate_limit=monitoring_v3.AlertPolicy.AlertStrategy.NotificationRateLimit(
            period=duration_pb2.Duration(seconds=300)
        )
    ),
    enabled=True,
)

created = client.create_alert_policy(name=project_name, alert_policy=policy)
print("ALERT_NAME:", created.name)
print("ALERT_DISPLAY:", created.display_name)

import os
import json
import google.auth
from google.auth.transport.requests import AuthorizedSession

PROJECT = os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']
PREFIX = os.environ['MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX']
JOB_ID = "4478837457281875968"

creds, _ = google.auth.default(
    scopes=["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring"]
)
session = AuthorizedSession(creds)

alert_name = f"{PREFIX}_flakycdcd16_failure_alert"

log_filter = (
    'resource.type="ml_job" '
    f'AND resource.labels.job_id="{JOB_ID}" '
    'AND severity>=ERROR'
)

policy = {
    "displayName": alert_name,
    "documentation": {
        "content": (
            "Failure alert for Vertex AI CustomJob 'flakycdcd16' "
            f"(display_name {PREFIX}_flakycdcd16, job id {JOB_ID}). "
            "Fires when the job emits an error log / fails."
        ),
        "mimeType": "text/markdown",
    },
    "combiner": "OR",
    "conditions": [
        {
            "displayName": "flakycdcd16 custom job failure (error log)",
            "conditionMatchedLog": {"filter": log_filter},
        }
    ],
    "alertStrategy": {
        "notificationRateLimit": {"period": "300s"}
    },
    "enabled": True,
}

url = f"https://monitoring.googleapis.com/v3/projects/{PROJECT}/alertPolicies"
resp = session.post(url, data=json.dumps(policy),
                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
print("HTTP", resp.status_code)
body = resp.json()
if resp.status_code >= 300:
    print(json.dumps(body, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("ALERT_NAME:", body.get("name"))
print("ALERT_DISPLAY:", body.get("displayName"))
